event_name: Date 07 October 2018 Time 11:48 2018 JAPANESE GRAND PRIX 04 - 07 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 29), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 3rd Energy Store (ES) has been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article 23.3 b). The team informed the Technical Delegate of the change to the power unit element on 6th October at 17:54.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
